description:
Use this when the user wants to clip in their saved style: "use my usual style", "what presets do I have".
        Returns each saved clipping preset with its id, name, caption look, logo, music and which switches are on (such
        as remove pauses or auto emojis). Pass an id or name to find_clips or clip_range as clipping_preset.
        Not for: browsing the editor's caption templates and fonts (edit_catalog) or restyling a finished clip
        (style_clip). Free and read only.
name: list_clipping_presets
title: List clipping presets
